spatial_autocorrelation_test.interpretation: Spatial coordinates (x,y) alone yield silhouette of only 0.0213 (ratio 0.1445 vs PCA-50), demonstrating that cell lineages are intermixed in physical space. BiLSTM achieves 0.4287 (20.10x higher than spatial alone), confirming its silhouette advantage reflects local transcriptomic expression smoothing rather than a spatial-coordinate artifact. However, this same spatial smoothing destroys local cell-specific variance required for GraphSAGE edge link prediction.
